label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to the response writer sink via println. Although the input undergoes a Base64 encode/decode round-trip, this operation is semantically equivalent to an identity transformation and does not sanitize or neutralize the payload. Consequently, the attacker-controlled string reaches the sink unescaped.

evidence.note: param flows from getParameter through Base64 roundtrip to bar, then to response.getWriter().println(bar)
